To perfectly parody the wildly famous 1980s “This Is Your Brain on Drugs” public service announcement, writers Marlon and Shawn Wayans decided to take the metaphor to its absolute, most literal conclusion. During a chaotic supernatural encounter in the haunted Hell House, the top of the notoriously weed-loving Shorty’s skull is violently sliced open, completely exposing his actual brain. However, instead of a terrifying, gory slasher moment, the film brilliantly subverts the horror by revealing his brain is just happily chilling out and smoking a tiny joint inside his head. By transforming a deeply serious, decades-old anti-drug campaign into a hilariously absurd practical effect, the Wayans brothers masterfully prove that the most brilliant cinematic parodies succeed by taking a tired, familiar metaphor and committing to it with unapologetic, literal ridiculousness.
⠀
Scary Movie 2 (2001), directed by Keenen Ivory Wayans, starring Anna Faris, Marlon Wayans, Shawn Wayans. A highly clumsy, deeply oblivious group of college students are lured to a fiercely haunted mansion under the guise of a sleep deprivation study, sparking a relentless, hilariously crude parody of the most iconic supernatural horror films.
